entities.summary: Blanca Padilla is a Spanish model who has worked for brands including Givenchy and Victoria's Secret. She has been described as one of the most well-known Spanish models on the international stage. Padilla is represented by Next Management; they also represent Abby Champion, Selena Forrest, Grace Hartzel, Lineisy Montero, Karmen Pedaru, and Binx Walton.
